4.9K views · 363 reactions | U.S. and Philippines Build AI Hub at Clark China Is Watching
The Philippines is transforming Clark from a former U.S. military base into a potential strategic economic and technology hub. At the center of this transformation is New Clark City and the proposed Pax Silica-linked high-tech industrial development, focused on semiconductors, artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing and resilient technology supply chains. Clark’s location, existing infrastructure, workforce and connection to Subic, Manila and Batangas through the Luzon Economic Corridor give Manila a potentially powerful platform for attracting higher-value investment. But the real question is whether the Philippines can turn foreign capital into lasting national capabilities through technology transfer, skilled employment, domestic suppliers and stronger industrial expertise. The project remains ambitious and its investment projections are not guaranteed, but if Manila executes effectively, Clark could evolve from a former American military installation into a major Philippine economic and strategic asset.
